description: This file defines a data transfer object (DTO) class 'LocationSearchFilterParams' used to encapsulate filter parameters for location search functionalities within the OrangeHRM system. It extends a base filter parameter class and contains properties for location name, city, and country code, along with associated getters and setters. It also specifies allowed sorting fields for location searches.

classes.name: LocationSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for encapsulating search filter parameters related to location entities for filtering and sorting location data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters with default sorting field 'location.name'.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the current location name filter value.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the location name filter value.

methods.name: getCity
methods.description: Returns the current city filter value.

methods.name: getCountryCode
methods.description: Returns the current country code filter value.

methods.name: setCountryCode
methods.description: Sets the country code filter value.
